messages.subject: Executive interest | Regional growth, ESG and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear LEO Global Logistics Leadership Team,

I am reaching you through LEO’s published corporate contact address after my earlier note to Investor Relations was rejected by my email provider before delivery. I would appreciate your routing my attached executive profile to the appropriate senior talent or business leader.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination, strategic partnerships and executive stakeholder strategy across a major industrial operation.

LEO’s regional logistics platform aligns with my experience coordinating public institutions, regulators, communities, contractors and internal teams around complex operating and sustainability priorities. I bring disciplined stakeholder governance, executive issue management and practical experience linking external commitments with accountable internal delivery.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional mandates across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, ESG, Strategic Partnerships or Country Leadership. I am internationally mobile and available following a 30-day notice period.

My attached CV is tailored to LEO Global Logistics. I would value a confidential discussion with the relevant senior leader.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
